texts: good. the "Each Keeper ..." universal becomes a fireable rule that gives every Keeper his own case, and "leather case" is recorded as a kind of case with nothing invented.

bad: all five contents hang off one "holds" event, so the record reads as a single holding of a five-item lump rather than the case holding each item separately, and "ground feathers" is recorded as one feather that happens to be ground instead of a set of feathers each of which is ground. Rewrite as one short clause per item and give the feathers their own referent: "The case holds a wick-trimmer. The case holds a clay flask of mire-essence. The case holds a striker. The case holds a jar of feathers, and those feathers are ground. The case holds a pouch of salt-bloom."
